other_failure_modes.name: No target transformation for highly skewed target
other_failure_modes.description: The model is trained directly on a highly skewed continuous target (e.g., revenue) without applying a variance-stabilizing transformation like log1p. This often causes models optimized for RMSE to overfit to extreme outliers and perform poorly across the general distribution.

summary: The agent implements a solid baseline using LightGBM and CatBoost with proper categorical encoding and early stopping. However, the solution lacks feature engineering, uses a naive unweighted ensemble, evaluates the models using a single random split, and critically fails to apply a log transformation to the highly skewed revenue target, which will likely harm RMSE performance.
